headline: Hunan report describes early site work for a planned 1,500P green-power compute center
summary: A Hunan MIIT report dated 2026-02-11 says land-leveling work was underway at the planned Zhiliang Xinghe Intelligent Cloud Computing Center site after a land transfer on 2025-12-11. It describes a planned RMB 5.2 billion investment, 1,500P of intelligent compute and a green-power direct-supply/compute-integration design. These are project plans and a dated early-site-work account, not evidence that the center is complete or operating.
